_comment: Generated by scripts/build_patch_data.py from the cached EA page in data/patch-source/. 'text' is EA's exact wording and must stay that way - scripts/build_patch_data.py --check re-reads EA's page and fails if any bullet is missing or altered. 'section' and 'items' are meant to be hand-corrected and are not overwritten by --check.

entries.text: Transitioning to aiming down sights with a Sniper Rifle while suppressed is now smoother when playing as a class other than Recon.
heading: PLAYER

entries.text: Soldier models, HUD, and UI elements now appear more quickly after deploying into a match.
heading: PLAYER

entries.text: Soldiers no longer play the "Falling Man Down” animation after briefly falling into water.
heading: PLAYER

entries.text: A duplicate crosshair no longer briefly appears when entering or exiting aiming down sights.
heading: PLAYER

entries.text: Players can no longer become stuck or pass through a stone foundation wall on Iberian Offensive.
heading: PLAYER

entries.text: Thermal Smoke Discharge now damages nearby enemies correctly when the vehicle is positioned on a slope.
heading: VEHICLES

entries.text: Main Battle Tank Canister Shells no longer incorrectly change into Aim-Guided Shells when switching between primary and secondary weapons during a reload.
heading: VEHICLES

entries.text: The 1P86 Variable Scope can no longer be used while operating an underbarrel launcher.
heading: WEAPONS

entries.text: Underbarrel attachment models on the M123K now update correctly when changing the equipped underbarrel attachment.
heading: WEAPONS

entries.text: The Season 3 Catch-Up Hardware Challenge for the PP-19 now correctly tracks Suppression Assists earned with SMGs.
heading: PROGRESSION

entries.text: The Season 4 Friday Night Battlefield Challenge now progresses correctly when completing a Friday Night Battlefield match as the host.
heading: PROGRESSION

entries.text: Players now spawn correctly during the PAX insertion sequence in Breakthrough on Tsuru Reef.
heading: MAPS & MODES

entries.text: Destroying the building next to the Palace on Cairo Bazaar no longer exposes unintended level geometry on the first floor.
heading: MAPS & MODES

entries.text: Pylons on Railway to Golmud now remain visible at medium distances, improving visibility for pilots.
heading: MAPS & MODES

entries.text: Corrected visual corruption near Objective C on Tsuru Reef that could cause intense flashing effects.
heading: MAPS & MODES

entries.text: Campaign Options can now be opened from the Select Difficulty screen.
heading: UI & HUD

entries.text: Console players can now like Portal experiences.
heading: UI & HUD

entries.text: The “Frontline Fixer” character skin now displays with the intended texture quality.
heading: UI & HUD

entries.text: An unintended placeholder sticker no longer appears in the weapon Stickers menu.
heading: UI & HUD

entries.text: The Loadouts screen no longer appears blank after returning to the Weapon Package menu through a Battlefield Pro Challenge deep link.
heading: UI & HUD

entries.text: Supply Crates in Portal Battle Royale experiences now remain synchronised after a player crashes and rejoins the match.
heading: PORTAL

entries.text: Corrected an issue on PC where certain NVIDIA GPUs could experience a driver crash when changing attachments on the SOR-300SC, using Custom Search, or playing on maps with large bodies of water.
heading: STABILITY

entries.text: Tanks in Battle Royale no longer remain stunned when entered immediately after sabotage ends.
heading: REDSEC
VEHICLES

entries.text: The lobby join sound effect no longer loops while starting a Battle Royale match.
